# DIRcreative

DIRcreative is a chat-first film preproduction Skill for Codex. It develops stories, screenplays, shots, visual-asset plans, continuity decisions, and model-ready prompts before image or video generation.

Source: https://github.com/papperrollinggery/Paperrolling-DIRcreative-SKILL
Release downloads: https://github.com/papperrollinggery/Paperrolling-DIRcreative-SKILL/releases/latest
Documentation: https://github.com/papperrollinggery/Paperrolling-DIRcreative-SKILL#documentation

Use the root `$dircreative` invocation in a Codex task. Published releases include only dependency snapshots that their licenses permit. External providers, including Jingzao, are independently installed and versioned.
